note: Set A is accurate but highly redundant (the 0.0255764 N·m/rpm² constant appears four times) and omits several key facts from the page: the peak power coefficient of 0.482 at a tip-speed ratio of 7.55, the 10% generator-slip in Region 2½, the Region 1½ speed range of 670–871 rpm, the 6.9 rpm minimum rotor speed, and the tabulated-function torque computation. Set B captures all of these, plus the -6 dB/octave stop-band roll-off and rated values, with mostly correct bindings. B's errors are a claim whose quote contains a '[missing]' gap, a misquote of '30% above this value (or 871 rpm)' as 'its rated value (or 871 rpm)', and a claim labeling 871 rpm as the lower bound of Region 1½ when it is the upper bound. Despite those flaws, B's coverage of the important quantitative facts makes it the better set.
